sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fairy moves and grass moves are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Hex, Mystical Fire, and Spirit Break: 1.5× stronger.
Aurora Beam, Bubble Beam, Charge Beam, Flash Cannon, Hyper Beam, Ice Beam, Magical Leaf, Psybeam, and Signal Beam: 1.4× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Moonblast, and Night Daze: 1.2× stronger.
Grass Whistle, Poison Powder, Sleep Powder, and Stun Spore: 85% accuracy.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fairy-type.
Secret Power can cause paralysis, poison, or sleep.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Purify changes the field into Forest.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Grounded Grass-type Pokémon recover 1/16 of their HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Special Defense +1 and takes root (Ingrain).

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
